collections.title: Bible & Faith
collections.summary: Interactive projects centered on Scripture knowledge, memorization, and Christian learning.
collections.editorialNote: Two different ways of returning to Scripture repeatedly: TMS60 concentrates on exact long-term verse recall, while The Bible Challenge turns biblical knowledge into active quiz play. Memorization and retrieval practice reinforce each other without becoming the same product.
relationshipLabels: Memorization ↔ retrieval play
TMS60 develops exact verse recall; The Bible Challenge exercises broader Scripture knowledge under playful retrieval pressure.

collections.title: Browser Games
collections.summary: Games and hosted play experiences that run directly in the browser, from arcade typing to long-form systems.
collections.editorialNote: A cross-section of how far a static browser can be pushed: arcade reflex games, social quiz formats, long-form incremental systems, atmospheric experiments, and progression-heavy action. The collection is organized by play pattern rather than by a single genre.
relationshipLabels: Typing as the core mechanic
Both transform keyboard accuracy into immediate game action, but use different spatial pressure models.
Systems & progression
Both ask the player to read systems, make trade-offs, and build value over repeated decisions.
Social quiz play
Both turn questions into group-friendly play, with one centered on Bible knowledge and the other on flexible quiz-night hosting.
Atmosphere & movement
These projects use audiovisual atmosphere and continuous movement to make browser play feel more spatial and game-like.
Long-run progression
Both support sessions where accumulating progression changes how later play feels.
Incremental systems
Analysis Idle and Nebula Foundry both use compounding progression loops, with different themes and pacing.
High-pressure interaction
Fast input and immediate feedback create pressure in both projects, despite very different mechanics.

collections.title: French Learning
collections.summary: Vocabulary, structured practice, and complementary systems for learning French.
collections.editorialNote: Three complementary layers of language acquisition: a broad spaced-repetition vocabulary base, a guided course-like notebook, and a lightweight flashcard set for focused review. The collection moves from exposure to structured practice to rapid retrieval.
relationshipLabels: Vocabulary → guided practice
French 3000 supplies breadth; Le Carnet places that vocabulary inside structured grammar, reading, and course practice.
Course practice → rapid review
The notebook builds context while the flashcards isolate weak items for quick retrieval practice.
Focused review → wider SRS
Small targeted review feeds back into the larger vocabulary system when broader retention work is needed.

collections.title: Mathematics & Computer Science
collections.summary: Study systems and experiments spanning university mathematics, algorithms, and exam preparation.
collections.editorialNote: A study-system cluster built around understanding difficult university material from different angles: exam simulation, structured theory, algorithm practice, and an experimental game-like interpretation of analysis. Together they form a loop from comprehension to retrieval to timed application.
relationshipLabels: Timed application ↔ theory
Klausurlabor stresses exam execution; Lernsystem supplies the underlying definitions, theorems, and conceptual structure.
Exam craft across subjects
Both systems convert university material into deliberate exam-style practice, but for different technical domains.
Formal concepts → playful systems
Analysis Idle reinterprets mathematical progression in a game-like form after the formal learning system establishes the concepts.
Algorithms ↔ systems thinking
Both reward recognizing structures and progression rules, one academically and one experimentally.

collections.title: Productivity & Creation
collections.summary: Practical tools for documents, publishing, and structured everyday workflows.
collections.editorialNote: Three tools built around turning messy inputs into controlled outputs: PDF Studio manipulates finished documents, Manuscript turns source text into publication-ready pages, and Clean30 turns an everyday environment into a finite workflow. The shared idea is structured transformation.
relationshipLabels: Finished documents ↔ source publishing
PDF Studio operates on existing documents; Manuscript creates polished documents from structured source.
Structured workflow
Both reduce a larger task into explicit ordered steps with visible progress toward a finished state.
Local task completion
Both emphasize direct local control, clear completion states, and practical work over account-driven collaboration.

collections.title: Typing Games
collections.summary: Fast browser games where keyboard accuracy and reaction speed are the core mechanic.
collections.editorialNote: Two experiments in making typing itself the game rather than a supporting control scheme. WORDSTRIKE uses whole incoming words and a central core; Wordfall turns typed targets into a different spatial defense rhythm. The connection is mechanical, not merely thematic.
relationshipLabels: Typing-driven defense
Both convert correct keyboard input into defense actions while using distinct target motion and pacing.
